name: unreal
description: Unreal Engine's light words (#433): point and spot lights in lumens or candela, centimetres and +Z up, each with its stated conversion. A word with no mapping is refused.

PointLight.conversion: cm and +Z up to m and +Y up; lumens kept, candela × 4π

SpotLight.conversion: cone lumens × 2 ÷ (1 − cos θ_outer); candela × 4π; cm and +Z up to m and +Y up
